description: Send an email in sandbox mode to a test inbox without delivering to your recipients

bcc.description: Optional BCC recipients as `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings also accepted)

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

category.description: Optional email category for tracking. Must be omitted when `template_uuid` is set.

cc.description: Optional CC recipients as `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings also accepted)

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

from.description: Sender as `{ email, name? }` (a bare email string is also accepted). Omit if `DEFAULT_FROM_EMAIL` is set.

html.description: Optional HTML version of the email body. Must be omitted when `template_uuid` is set.

subject.description: Email subject line. Required for inline (text/html) sends; must be omitted when `template_uuid` is set.

template_uuid.description: Use a Mailtrap email template instead of inline content. When set, `subject`, `text`, `html`, and `category` must be omitted (per Mailtrap API).

template_variables.description: Variables substituted into the template referenced by `template_uuid`. Only allowed together with `template_uuid`; rejected otherwise.

test_inbox_id.description: Mailtrap test inbox ID. Optional if MAILTRAP_TEST_INBOX_ID env var is set. Use to target a specific inbox.

text.description: Email body text. Required (alongside or instead of `html`) for inline sends; must be omitted when `template_uuid` is set.

to.description: Recipients as an array of `{ email, name? }` objects (bare email strings as items, or a comma-separated string of plain emails, are also accepted). Optional if `cc` or `bcc` is provided; at least one of `to`/`cc`/`bcc` must contain a recipient.

items.description: Address with optional display name (a bare email string is also accepted)

name: send-sandbox-email
